comparisons.scope: Continuous signatures/validity differ: same logical business, not same-byte cross-version causality. Two CPU sample arithmetic mean is descriptive, not a certified throughput bound.

observed_process_attribution.scope: Observed same-byte AAD-only before/after; full-process CPU snapshots are whole drive accounting. Hot-TID ratios use only two fully-in-drive sampled process snapshots and their time midpoints, not function names or whole-round per-transaction attribution. Memory sample maxima are lower bounds; OS peak values span process lifetime. No ETW/build/load launched by analysis.

validation_issues.message: Initial recovery did not start: companion novovm-native-client absent. Built and copied matching candidate client; reran full recovery successfully. No node recovery failure was hidden.

After successful recovery, an outer check of LASTEXITCODE for a PowerShell script falsely stopped the following microbenchmark. Actual original harness/run.json exit0 and completed=true. Repeated benchmark/targeted tests then ran independently and passed; do not count the wrapper message as a node failure.
